headline: Police SI beaten to death in Savar after protesting assault
summary: A 60-year-old Special Branch officer was killed by a mob of 20-25 people in Aminbazar, Savar, while trying to stop the beating of an elderly man.
details: A 60-year-old Sub-Inspector (SI) of the Special Branch (SB) of the Bangladesh Police, Md. Altab Hossain, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.
The incident occurred on Saturday night when the officer intervened to protest the assault of an elderly man.
During the confrontation, a mob of 20-25 people attacked both the officer and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, using indigenous weapons.
SI Altab Hossain was killed in the attack, while his son Ariful was seriously injured and is currently receiving treatment at a hospital.
The attack took place near a garment factory in Aminbazar, where the mob targeted the father and son.
caption:
A Special Branch police officer was beaten to death by a mob of 25 people for simply trying to stop the assault of an elderly man.

A 60-year-old Sub-Inspector (SI) of the Special Branch (SB) of the Bangladesh Police, Md. Altab Hossain, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.

The incident occurred on Saturday night when the officer intervened to protest the assault of an elderly man.

During the confrontation, a mob of 20-25 people attacked both the officer and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, using indigenous weapons.

SI Altab Hossain was killed in the attack, while his son Ariful was seriously injured and is currently receiving treatment at a hospital.

The attack took place near a garment factory in Aminbazar, where the mob targeted the father and son.

headline_marked: Bidisha Siddique: [[High Court grants bail in fraud case]], no bar to release
headline: Bidisha Siddique: High Court grants bail in fraud case, no bar to release
summary: The former wife of late president HM Ershad has been granted bail by the High Court, clearing the way for her release from jail.
details: The High Court has granted bail to Bidisha Siddique, the former wife of late president and Jatiya Party founder HM Ershad, in a connection with a fraud case.
A bench of Justice Md Khairul Alam and Justice Md Rafizul Islam passed the order after hearing a petition filed by Bidisha.
Bidisha's legal counsel, Advocate Masud Mia, stated that since no other cases are pending against her, there is no legal bar to her release.
She was arrested from a restaurant in Gulshan on August 25 and sent to jail on August 26.
The case stems from a 2008 lawsuit filed by businessman Mosharraf Hossain, alleging fraud in the sale of a flat in the Mirpur-10 area of Dhaka.
Earlier, on May 20, a Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court had sentenced her to two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Tk 10,000.
caption:
Former wife of late president HM Ershad, Bidisha Siddique, is set for release after the High Court granted her bail in a fraud case.

The High Court has granted bail to Bidisha Siddique, the former wife of late president and Jatiya Party founder HM Ershad, in a connection with a fraud case.

A bench of Justice Md Khairul Alam and Justice Md Rafizul Islam passed the order after hearing a petition filed by Bidisha.

Bidisha's legal counsel, Advocate Masud Mia, stated that since no other cases are pending against her, there is no legal bar to her release.

She was arrested from a restaurant in Gulshan on August 25 and sent to jail on August 26.

The case stems from a 2008 lawsuit filed by businessman Mosharraf Hossain, alleging fraud in the sale of a flat in the Mirpur-10 area of Dhaka.

Earlier, on May 20, a Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court had sentenced her to two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Tk 10,000.
